name: Content Campaign
description: Plan a content campaign: a brief, a content calendar and draft posts for the channels and dates you choose.
metadataOnlyNote: Template metadata only: this version records inputs and planned outputs. Workflows, agents and quality checks arrive in later milestones (M3/M4).

inputFields.label: Organization or product
inputFields.help: Who or what the campaign is about.

inputFields.label: Objective
inputFields.help: What the campaign should achieve, e.g. sign-ups for an event.

inputFields.label: Channels
inputFields.help: Where the posts would appear. Atlas Realm drafts posts. It never publishes them.

inputFields.label: Content constraints
inputFields.help: Words to avoid, required disclaimers, length limits and similar rules.

inputFields.label: Source materials
inputFields.help: Files that claims in the posts may rely on.

artifactTypes.name: Campaign brief
artifactTypes.description: Audience, objective, tone and key messages.

artifactTypes.name: Content calendar
artifactTypes.description: One row per planned post: date, channel and topic.

artifactTypes.name: Post drafts
artifactTypes.description: Draft text for each planned post, for your review.

offlineLimitations: No live trend research: it uses only the source materials you supply.
No image generation. Posts are text only.
It never publishes or schedules posts. You publish them yourself.
